name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
clause: Whenever another creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. If this is the fourth time this ability has resolved this turn, transform ~.

needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'nth-resolution-this-turn'; value: number } backed by a per-turn resolution tally kept on the ability and cleared at cleanup
needs.semantics: 'If this is the fourth time this ability has resolved this turn, transform ~.' The engine keeps `triggeredThisTurn` (a once-per-turn set keyed by ability text) but no count of RESOLUTIONS, and a condition evaluated during resolution cannot see one.
needs.clause: If this is the fourth time this ability has resolved this turn, transform ~.

needs.proposedSignature: AsEnters gains { kind: 'as-transforms'; to?: 'front' | 'back'; effects: Effect[] } - a replacement applied as the permanent turns over, not a trigger after it
needs.semantics: 'As this creature transforms into Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel, you get an emblem with ...' and 'As this creature transforms into Shinryu, choose an opponent.' The transform family has the `transforms` TRIGGER, which is 'when', so anything printed as 'As ... transforms' can only be approximated after the fact.
needs.clause: // As ~ transforms into ~, you get an emblem with "Whenever a creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
